title: Print Window Border Gap
description: Print windows have a small gap between the title bar first line and the window content box; borders should touch seamlessly.
summary: Fixed the missing left edge in long-table header rows by making the first header cell explicitly own and render the left vertical rule. Applied the same header construction to generic, register, glossary, and abbreviation long tables; added source-layout regression assertions; removed obsolete blockquote assertions; verified a five-column reproduction at 300 dpi; and passed the uncached full 12-PDF light/dark print suite.
